system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: deds_submit_project and deds_get_scheme_details.. my project_cost is dummy_project_cost_1607, my beneficiary_category is dummy_beneficiary_category_6824, my project_type is dummy_project_type_9860, my aadhaar_number is 100020006844, my location is dummy_location_9892.

function.name: deds_get_scheme_details
function.description: Returns detailed information about DEDS scheme including eligible projects, subsidy percentages, caps, and bank requirements. PUBLIC tool — no session required. Does NOT check individual eligibility. Advisory only. Fails if scheme details are temporarily unavailable.

function.name: deds_submit_project
function.description: Submits a detailed project proposal for DEDS subsidy. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Farmer must be eligible. Does NOT approve the application or sanction loans. Fails if farmer is ineligible, proposal is incomplete, or duplicate application exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

project_cost.description: Estimated total project cost in INR.
